extracted.name: Baked Sliced Peaches
extracted.description: This baked sliced peaches recipe makes a quick and easy dessert any time of the year using frozen peach slices, pecans, flour, brown sugar, and vanilla.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Arrange peach slices in a single layer in a baking dish. Combine brown sugar substitute, pecans, flour, and vanilla extract in a bowl until evenly mixed; spread over peach slices.
Bake in the preheated oven until peaches are heated through, 20 to 30 minutes.
